_about: PROPOSED banned and translationese lists (BRIEF-DIALOGUE Phase 2; docs/voice-tr.md §7, docs/voice-en.md §7). Read by tools/check-banned.js. Patterns are JS regexes, flags 'iu'. Unicode-aware word edges use (?<![\p{L}]) and (?![\p{L}]). 'guardrail' = must be zero hits (AGENTS.md Writer Guardrails); 'flag' = goes to the editor, not a failure; 'review' = context call by an editor. Owner approves the contents before Phase 3.

tr.why: no ethnic or regional jokes
religion is never an oath or a joke target (ezan is ambient only, D-035)
no politics, parties or state actors
no earthquake talk or imagery
no body-shaming
no real brands or club crests
no real people
tier 4: no slurs, no mother-based insults

en.why: religion is never an oath or a joke target
no politics, parties or state actors
no real brands or club crests
no real people or real show names
en.re: (?<![\p{L}])(messi|ronaldo|tarkan|shaun of the dead|south park|rick and morty|walking dead|resident evil|left 4 dead)(?![\p{L}])

en.why: tier 4: no slurs, no mother-based insults

tr.why: translationese: 'konveyör' for a belt/line
translationese from 'personal space'
stock foreigner Turkish: 'dostum' for a buddy
'enfekte' is textbook; Turks say 'ısırıldın mı?'
translationese from 'This is a tactic'
formal plural between friends ('siz', '-ınız') reads like a subtitle
English word in a Turkish line; whitelist: OK, GPS, scooter, Wi-Fi, SMS
volume instead of voice

en.why: two or more Turkish words in one line reads like a tour guide
no parenthetical glosses of Turkish words

en.re: survival is|patience and|life is (cruel|short)|never give up|believe in yourself

tr.why: Arda says 'yakmayın / verin / dönün' to himself or a friend; use the singular (D-052 voice rules). Fine in shouts to a crowd, signs and announcements: editor decides.
Arda names his parents 'annem / babam / dedem' in the third person; 'Anne / Baba / Dede' only as direct address (Anne, ...). Speakers other than Arda may differ: editor decides.
body-shaming check. Owner decision 2026-11-09: the Turkish boss name is 'Dombili' (affectionate nickname, a name only; no weight jokes). Editor confirms it stays a name; any other hit is a real flag.
'belediye' = a real institution; check the joke is not political

en.why: body-shaming check. Owner decision 2026-11-09: English name is 'Bloated Waiter'; any 'fat' hit is a real flag.
'city' / 'municipality' = a real institution; check the joke is not political

profanity._about: owner direction 2026-11-09: swearing allowed. Tiers and caps are PROPOSED (voice-*.md §6). The checker reports counts; Phase 3 turns the caps into tests once approved.

ownerExceptions._about: Per-line owner exceptions (decision D-052 PROPOSED, 2026-11-10): the owner approved these exact lines despite a guardrail or flag rule. Key = "<beat>#<variant>", value = rule ids to skip. Only the listed rule is skipped, only for that line; new lines still hit the rule.
